# durantic Provider

Use the Durantic provider to manage [Durantic](https://durantic.io) platform infrastructure as code — machine roles and configuration, mesh networks, routes and route policy sets, virtual IPs, registry credentials, secrets backends, and account secrets and variables — and to look up existing machines and images. Authenticate with a Durantic API token via the `DURANTIC_API_TOKEN` environment variable (or the `api_token` argument).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

provider "durantic" {
  endpoint  = "https://api.app.durantic.dev" # or set DURANTIC_ENDPOINT
  api_token = "your-api-token"                # or set DURANTIC_API_TOKEN
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) API token for Durantic authentication. Can also be set via DURANTIC_API_TOKEN environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Durantic API endpoint URL. Can also be set via DURANTIC_ENDPOINT environment variable. Defaults to https://api.app.durantic.dev
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Can also be set via DURANTIC_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY environment variable. Defaults to false. **WARNING:** This should only be used in development/testing environments.
